body.p1: The data controller is Michał Janiec, running a sole-trader business as Michał Janiec - FrontDev, Katowice, Poland, tax ID (NIP) 9542827947, email: <email></email>.
body.p2: Data from the form (name, email, company, project description) is used only to answer your enquiry and prepare an offer (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR).
body.p3: Messages are sent through Mailgun (Sinch Mailgun, US servers; transfers outside the EEA rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses). I don't sell or share data with anyone else.
